name: Delaware Basin (Permian) onshore production, monthly per facility
description: Facility-level monthly production for the production-permian-delaware layer: every well the state files reported in the trailing 120 months, with surface coordinates, current, prior and last-year readings, a ten-year summary, field and county clusters, and on-demand history shards. Current = the newest complete filing month, by rule.
license_note: Public record of the Railroad Commission of Texas; RRC site policies grant permission for noncommercial use, and the founder decided on 2026-09-28 to show it on the hosted site (docs/LICENCES.md)

shards.note: Built alongside the index from the archived workbooks (O1, option a); a checkout without them shows the index and says so in the dossier.

eia.name: oil
eia.description: Texas Field Production of Crude Oil (Thousand Barrels)

completeness.rule: newest month whose count of facilities that filed is at least the threshold share of the median over the preceding lookback of months, that median being at least the floor share of the median over the lookback before it
completeness.reporterRule: oil leases and gas wells with a production report filed for the month (PROD_REPORT_FILED_FLAG Y)

reconciliation.note: State filings are gross gas at the wellhead as reported by operators; EIA gross withdrawals include estimates for wells the state file omits (confidential wells, late filers), marketed production excludes gas flared, vented and used for repressuring. Region totals exclude nothing the files carry.

assumptions.datum: NAD83 (RRC’s LAT83 / LONG83 columns in the well layers)
assumptions.transform: none — RRC publishes NAD83 beside the NAD27 originals; an oil lease is drawn at the centroid of its wells, a gas well at its own surface location
assumptions.precision: well coordinates rounded to six decimals
assumptions.reporterRule: oil leases and gas wells with a production report filed for the month (PROD_REPORT_FILED_FLAG Y)
assumptions.finality: a monthly snapshot: RRC revises earlier months as corrected reports arrive, so each dump can change past months; --refresh reads the newest dump

reproduce.raw_archive: Every workbook is archived verbatim under .gev-cache/onshore/<state>/ (git-ignored) with a .retrieved sidecar; parsed rows are cached beside it keyed by sha256; --replay rebuilds from the archive, --check diffs against the committed bytes.
